card.name: Glucose given to treat low blood sugar
card.fires_on: The words glucose or sugar when they name the treatment given for hypoglycemia, usually after give, oral, intravenous, or fast-acting.

modes.label: Oral or IV glucose
modes.description: The word glucose right after oral, intravenous, or give in hypoglycemia treatment advice.
modes.example: If a patient develops hypoglycemia, give<< glucose>> orally or intravenously.

modes.label: Fast-acting sugar
modes.description: The word sugar as a quick fix for low blood sugar in patient-friendly advice.
modes.example: Give your child 15 to 20 grams of fast-acting<< sugar>> such as 3 to 4 glucose

card.plain: It lights up on the word glucose or sugar when the text says to give it to treat low blood sugar.
evidence: Give your child 15 to 20 grams of fast-acting<< sugar>> such as 3 to 4 glucose
Mild episodes of hypoglycemia usually can be treated with oral<< glucose>>.
